meta.name: glab
meta.description: Expert guidance for using the GitLab CLI (glab) to manage GitLab issues, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, repositories, and other GitLab operations from the command line. Use this skill when the user needs to interact with GitLab resources or perform GitLab workflows.

copy.tagline: 学会用命令行高效管理 GitLab 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常通过命令行操作 GitLab 并想提升效率
copy.tagline_en: Learn to manage GitLab projects efficiently from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently operate GitLab via CLI and want to boost productivity

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的需求，指导你如何使用 glab（GitLab 官方命令行工具）在终端中管理 Issues、合并请求、CI/CD 流水线等 GitLab 资源。
howto.when: 当你需要从终端操作 GitLab 资源（如创建合并请求、查看 Issue、监控流水线等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个合并请求，标题是“修复登录bug”。
查看我负责的所有 Issue。
如何检查 CI 流水线状态？

howto.what_en: Claude provides step-by-step guidance on using the glab CLI to perform GitLab operations like managing issues, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines from the terminal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to interact with GitLab resources via command line, such as creating merge requests, viewing issues, or monitoring pipelines.

say_en.text: Help me create a merge request with title 'Fix login bug'.
say_en.note: Claude will output the glab mr create command.

say_en.text: Show all issues assigned to me.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest glab issue list --assignee=@me.

say_en.text: How to check CI pipeline status?
say_en.note: Claude will explain glab ci status or similar.
